messages:
Sam (Peregrine): Hey team — we want to onboard a small reranker fine-tuned on our microservices logs to improve search relevance. Need privacy-first setup: no PHI, keys stay on our side (HSM), and we want an eval plan before go-live.
Maya (CS): Thanks Sam — noted. Quick Qs: target throughput/latency? Do you want Hosted with dedicated pool or Private (VPC/on‑prem)?
Sam (Peregrine): Target < 100ms p95 for single-turn rerank, ~200 qps. Prefer Private VPC initially, but willing to start in Dedicated to speed up test. Also, we will provide a 2k-record golden set for eval (redacted).
Maya (CS): Got it. Looping in Leo for infra/throughput sizing and Erin for safety/data handling. @Leo @Erin
Leo (SolutionsEng): Thanks — I can size dedicated pool for 200 qps, but p95 <100ms depends on model quant and sequence length. Can you share avg seq len and model size (base vs 7B vs 13B)?
Sam (Peregrine): Avg seq length ~120 tokens. We're proposing a 3B dense reranker, quantized to int8 if possible. Budget note: dev/test can be lower perf.
Erin (Safety): Important: ensure dataset has been redacted of any PII/PHI. We'll need the evaluation checklist filled out and the prompt sets for regression tests. Also request: no logging of raw inputs in hosted infra; confirm retention policy.
Maya (CS): Action items I see: 1) Peregrine to upload redacted golden set + prompt list (S3 link or secure upload to our intake SFTP). 2) Leo to propose a Dedicated sizing & latency estimate. 3) Erin to provide safety checklist + minimal eval harness. 4) CS to schedule 30m kickoff with Peregrine.
Sam (Peregrine): I'll upload redacted set to the intake SFTP by EOD tomorrow and share the link here. We can do a kickoff Wed PST.
Leo (SolutionsEng): I'll spin up a test runner with a 3B quantized profile and run a synthetic pass. Expect initial numbers in 48h.
Erin (Safety): I'll attach the eval checklist template in this thread — it's the one we use for domain rerankers. We need: distribution tests, hallucination spot checks, and false-positive/negative analysis on golden set.
Maya (CS): Kicking off calendar invite for Wed 10:30am PST. Also tagging `deploy-bot` to create an intake ticket:
deploy-bot: New intake created — ticket ID CS-9842 — Peregrine reranker onboarding. Owner: Maya (CS). SLA: 5 business days for initial eval pass.
Sam (Peregrine): Thanks all. One ask: can we enable HSM key wrap for the model weights in Private? Security contact will follow up with contact info.
Erin (Safety): For Private/VPC we support customer KMS/HSM integrations — we'll capture the HSM requirements in the intake ticket. Please send specifics (vendor, key policy).
Leo (SolutionsEng): Noted — I'll include a deploy checklist: model artifact format, quantization steps, kernel compat, and perf test script. Example perf command we'll run:
```bash
python perf_run.py --model ./artifacts/reranker-q3b-int8 --batch 8 --seq 128 --measure p95
```
Maya (CS): Great. I'll update CS-9842 with links to threads, the kickoff invite, and Erin's checklist. We'll reconvene after Leo's perf numbers. :thumbsup:
Sam (Peregrine): Appreciate it — talk Wed.
Maya (CS): Closing loop for now. If anyone needs temp access to Peregrine's golden set, ping me and I'll coordinate secure share.
